name: Kintsugi
author: Erin Carter
description: Gold-repaired pottery: a palette-tinted ceramic glaze body fills the frame, fractured into shards by an interconnected Voronoi crack network whose edges run as molten gold seams - deep ember in the hollows rising to bright liquid gold on the ridges, with a slow shimmer creeping along each repair. A faint craze of hairline cracks textures the glaze. The kintsugi mend reads as a dense web of gold across the whole surface, never a few floating strands on black.

params.label: Shards
params.effect: How many shards the pottery breaks into; low gives a few large pieces with bold gold rivers, high a fine mosaic of small fragments laced with a tight gold web.

params.label: Seam width
params.effect: Width of the gold repair seams in CSS pixels - a hairline lacquer line at the minimum, a generous molten channel of liquid gold at the maximum.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Intensity and speed of the molten shimmer travelling the seams; 0 lets the gold rest as a steady gleam, 2 keeps every mend quietly boiling.
